content.thinking: Right: F[2] = 10**12 + 5 > 1e12 ✓ correctly rejected. Let me use times ≤ 1e12: [10**12 - 5, 10**12 - 1, 10**12].

LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native timeout 600 python3 /workspace/dev/extreme.py
